	OR = {

		}
		AND = {
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 1 }
			has_variable = tv_academy_debate_meritocracy_progressive
		}
		AND = {
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 2 }
			has_embraced_institution = institution:renaissance
		}
		AND = {
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 2 }
			has_variable = tv_academy_debate_renaissance_progressive
		}
		AND = {
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 3 }
			has_embraced_institution = institution:banking
		}
		AND = {
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 3 }
			has_variable = tv_academy_debate_banking_progressive

			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 4 }
			has_embraced_institution = institution:new_world
		}

			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 4 }
			has_variable = tv_academy_debate_new_world_progressive
		}

			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 5 }
			has_embraced_institution = institution:printing_press
		}

			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 5 }
			has_variable = tv_academy_debate_printing_press_progressive
		}
		AND = {
			situation:tv_academy_world_debate_situation = { var:tv_academy_world_debate_issue ?= 6 }
			has_embraced_institution = institution:confessionalism
		}
		AND = {

		}

		}
